1.why: A clean sans-serif face is used at a comfortable size with roomy line spacing between paragraph lines and clear separation of labels and fields.

2.why: No italics or dense paragraphs appear and body text is short, though letter-spaced all-caps is used for 'NORTHSTAR BANK' and the 'Step 1 of 3' eyebrow labels.

3.why: The single-column card with full-width fields and buttons looks mobile-friendly, but all screenshots are captured at desktop width so mobile rendering is unverified.

4.why: Every instruction is one short plain sentence, e.g. 'Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone. The code expires in 10 minutes.'

5.why: The mobile number field shows an example placeholder '+447700900000', but the email field and the six-digit code field give no example of expected input.

6.why: No screen contains more than two short sentences of instructional text before the action button.

7.why: No secret, OTP seed or recovery code is ever displayed and no copy control appears anywhere in the captured flow.

8.why: No QR code or scan alternative is shown; the flow never reaches authenticator enrolment and only offers manual code typing.

9.why: There is no visible indication of autofill/password-manager support (no password field, no one-time-code hints or autofill affordances observed).

10.why: A 'Step 2 of 3' indicator sits above the heading and the primary action is a large filled, high-contrast full-width button distinct from the secondary link.

11.why: Each screen asks for one thing with a single primary button, though a secondary 'Use different details' link and a 'Logs' panel add extra elements.

12.why: After submitting the code the only feedback is the vague banner 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.', the Logs box stays empty, and no next step is stated.

13.why: Retrying is possible by resubmitting the field, but there is no resend/re-request code option and no reveal/hide control for any code.

14.why: The error banner is non-blaming but does not identify the problem or say how to fix it, only 'Please try again.'

15.why: No countdown or forced timeout on reading is shown, but the code is stated to expire in 10 minutes with no option to extend or request more time.
